how: the mathematics of the lane's review of another seat's X-ENDGAME campaign, on main (checks/physical_endgame_review.py; neither the lane's own checker nor that seat's scripts are run): four sentences it quotes are at their cited lines. THE CARRIER: the mapping torus of the punctured torus by M = [[2, 1], [1, 1]] has boundary matrix of rank 2, so H_2 = 0, H_1 = Z and H^2 = 0; that seat's 'H^2(M_3; Z) = Z' is the closed torus's (the extra 2-cell gives it); a source-free curvature integrates to zero over the boundary torus. THE FOURTH COVER: M^4 - 1 = [[33, 21], [21, 12]] has Smith form (3, 15); its 45 fixed points are 1 + 8 + 4 + 32 by exact order; on the 32 points M has 8 orbits, J four and -1 sixteen. THE MIXED PRODUCTS: main had read the primary source's order itself (record agy002-g0-05) and holds the coefficient 11/2 against the exchanged order's 7 in its lock; the two orders differ by (3/4)[H_u, H_d] Y_u, which changes the rate of Tr(H_u H_d) by (3/2) Tr([H_u, H_d]^2) and is invisible on commuting inputs. A sum of terms of one modular type keeps that type for any constant coefficients. THE AREA: c A + 2 pi^2 I^2/A is stationary at sqrt(2) pi I/sqrt(c): 6 pi, 6 sqrt 2 pi, 3 sqrt 2 pi. THE COLLAR: the two normalised end values have ratio exp(k L). The base circle carries a free character (the free summand of H_1). The raw phase of det(Y_u Y_d) moves under right unitaries, so it is not a basis-invariant obstruction by itself
